aiModelsTab.apiKeysIntro: Your org's own API key for each vendor, used for AI-assisted operations assigned to that vendor. If unset for a vendor, the deployment's default key is used. Keys are never shown once saved.
aiModelsTab.apiKeyNotSet: No key set — using deployment default
aiModelsTab.apiKeyWillClear: The key will be cleared when you save.
aiModelsTab.modelsIntro: Vendor and model used for each AI-assisted operation. Vendor accepts any aisuite-supported name (e.g. anthropic, openai, ollama for a local model). Leave the model blank to reset that operation to the default.
aiModelsTab.nlIntro: Requests per minute per role for NL-to-SQL. Leave empty for unlimited.
aiModelsTab.vectorIntro: Registered embedding models available for semantic search. The registry is an allowlist.
aiModelsTab.savedRestartRequired: Saved. Restart the service to apply.
